services.name: Glampingnear me
services.desc: Yurts with hardwood flooring and full bathrooms provide an upscale camping alternative near the Doe River. Each unit includes a queen bed and complete shower facilities, allowing campers to stargaze through overhead windows while staying comfortable indoors. The site sits close to Doe River Landing and other area campgrounds. Rates run $125-150 per night with standard campground amenities like fire rings, picnic tables, and firewood available for purchase. Reservations are recommended for this drive-in accessible property that combines outdoor recreation access with indoor comfort features. services.name: RV Parks
services.desc: Within Roan Mountain State Park, this campground operates year-round at elevations that bring cooler temperatures and mountain weather patterns. The Tennessee State Park system manages 87 sites spread across multiple loops, with tent sites numbered 1-40 and RV sites filling the remainder. Sites along the lower section follow the Doe River, which flows as more of a creek through the camping area. The campground divides into distinct zones that create different experiences. Lower loop sites like 40, 41, 44, 46, 48, 50, and 52 feature paved pads and direct creek access, while upper sections climb hillier terrain with more challenging leveling. Mary D. notes "there really isn't a bad spot"

blurb: Fishing and riverside access draw campers to Doe River Primitive Campground, a drive-in, walk-in, and hike-in site set on open terrain along the Doe River in Roan Mountain, Tennessee. The campground is privately managed and includes toilets, picnic tables, firewood, trash service, and WiFi. Fires are permitted. Pets are welcome.
